An '''alphabet''' was used by the [[Houk/Legends|Houk]] [[Species/Legends|species]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lijuter]] to write their [[Language/Legends|language]], [[Houkese]]. The primitive alphabet contained a set of letters that were used to represent simple verbs, while complicated pictograms were used to write nouns.<ref name="Ultimate Alien Anthology" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Houkese alphabet was mentioned in ''[[Ultimate Alien Anthology]]'', a [[2003]] sourcebook published by [[Wizards of the Coast]] for use with the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="Ultimate Alien Anthology" />
